title.zh-CN: 术后恶心伴转氨酶进行性升高 · 29岁女性

summary.zh-CN: 围绕术后恶心伴转氨酶进行性升高，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for postoperative nausea with progressively rising aminotransferases.

name.zh-CN: 调阅药物成分及发药记录

zh-CN: 调阅药物成分及发药记录

text.zh-CN: 每片含对乙酰氨基酚 500 mg、双氢可待因 10 mg；记录总计 20 片，即对乙酰氨基酚 10 g 分次摄入。
text.en: Each tablet contained paracetamol 500 mg and dihydrocodeine 10 mg; twenty tablets amount to 10 g paracetamol in divided ingestions.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 术前 ALT 12、AST 18 U/L；术后先升至 ALT 112、后 1128 U/L，并继续上升。
text.en: Preoperative ALT 12 and AST 18 U/L; ALT later rose through 112 to 1128 U/L and continued rising.

text.zh-CN: ALT 峰值 2510 U/L；原报告多种支持治疗后下降，约 3 周后 ALT 34、AST 18 U/L。未记载 NAC 使用，不能将缺失写成已给药。
text.en: ALT peaked at 2510 U/L and fell during multiple supportive treatments; roughly three weeks later ALT was 34 and AST 18 U/L. NAC use was not recorded and must not be invented.

text.zh-CN: 复方镇痛药中对乙酰氨基酚累计超量
text.en: Excess cumulative paracetamol in a combination analgesic

feedback.zh-CN: 成分与服用次数提示明确的过量风险。
feedback.en: Formulation and repeated dosing establish an overdose risk.

text.zh-CN: 只因术前低血压就排除药物因素
text.en: Preoperative hypotension excludes drug contribution

feedback.zh-CN: 可有多个因素，不能忽略已核对的摄入。
feedback.en: Multiple factors may coexist; the documented ingestion cannot be ignored.

text.zh-CN: 没有肝炎史意味着不可能肝损伤
text.en: No hepatitis history means liver injury is impossible

prompt.zh-CN: 当前应如何处置这种暴露与肝损伤？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 立即停可疑复方药并联系中毒/肝病团队，评估 NAC、凝血、肾功能和脑病
text.en: Stop the suspect combination and urgently involve toxicology/hepatology for NAC and severity assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 已有肝损伤不能仅用非特异“保肝”药等待。
feedback.en: Established injury should not be managed by waiting on nonspecific “liver-protective” drugs alone.

text.zh-CN: 等转氨酶自行下降再做用药核对
text.en: Wait for enzymes to fall before medication reconciliation

feedback.zh-CN: 延误暴露确认和解毒评估。
feedback.en: That delays exposure confirmation and antidote assessment.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭没有黄疸就排除严重风险
text.en: No jaundice excludes serious risk

feedback.zh-CN: 肝细胞损伤与胆红素不必平行。
feedback.en: Hepatocellular injury and bilirubin need not rise together.

prompt.en: How should the reported recovery be interpreted?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 支持暴露相关肝损伤，但不能证明每种“保肝”药有效或没有 NAC 需求
text.en: Recovery supports exposure-related injury, not efficacy of every supportive drug or absence of a NAC indication

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告未记录 NAC，不能据康复倒推最佳处理。
feedback.en: NAC was not recorded; recovery does not retrospectively validate optimal care.

text.zh-CN: 只要康复，原发药说明已经充分
text.en: Recovery proves the original instructions were adequate

feedback.zh-CN: 给药间隔和累计量未充分说明。
feedback.en: Intervals and cumulative limits were inadequately communicated.

text.zh-CN: ALT 很高就等于已证实肝衰竭
text.en: Very high ALT alone proves liver failure

feedback.zh-CN: 还需凝血和脑病等证据。
feedback.en: Coagulation and encephalopathy evidence are also needed.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 复方镇痛药分次超量后出现严重肝细胞损伤，核心教学是成分核对、及时中毒评估和用药沟通。
conclusion.en: Divided overdose of a combination analgesic preceded severe hepatocellular injury; key lessons are ingredient reconciliation, urgent toxicology assessment and dosing communication.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 应累计所有复方制剂中的同一成分。
keyReasoning.en: Count the same ingredient across combination products.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 2023 中毒共识支持依据时序、浓度及肝损伤评估 NAC。
keyReasoning.en: The 2023 poisoning consensus supports NAC assessment using timing, concentrations and liver injury.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 分次摄入及合并阿片会影响浓度解释，不能机械套图。
keyReasoning.en: Divided ingestion and co-ingested opioids complicate concentration interpretation; do not mechanically apply a nomogram.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 药物浓度、INR、体重、脑病及 NAC 是否使用未载。
unknowns.en: Drug concentration, INR, weight, encephalopathy and NAC use are absent.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 应累计所有复方制剂中的同一成分。
teachingPoints.en: Count the same ingredient across combination products.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 2023 中毒共识支持依据时序、浓度及肝损伤评估 NAC。
teachingPoints.en: The 2023 poisoning consensus supports NAC assessment using timing, concentrations and liver injury.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分次摄入及合并阿片会影响浓度解释，不能机械套图。
teachingPoints.en: Divided ingestion and co-ingested opioids complicate concentration interpretation; do not mechanically apply a nomogram.
